title: Natural Earth 1:10m Cultural Vectors – Admin 0 countries (v5.1.2): Canada
license: Public domain (Natural Earth terms of use)
attribution: Made with Natural Earth. Free vector and raster map data @ naturalearthdata.com. Canada's outline, simplified, is used only to check that a trip starts and ends in Canada.
notes: Owner decision B74 (2026-11-17): the trip function refuses a start or destination outside Canada before calling openrouteservice. Downloaded by hand with npm run fetch:canada, which writes data/imported/naturalearth/canada.json (with the download's checksum); only the function reads it, browsers never download it.
